definitions.explanation: a small piece of paper with adhesive backing used for notes, bookmarks, or labels

examples.japanese: {大事|だいじ}なページに{付箋|ふせん}を{付|つ}けた。
examples.english: I put a sticky note on the important page.

examples.japanese: カラフルな{付箋|ふせん}でノートを{整理|せいり}する。
examples.english: I organize my notebook with colorful sticky notes.

notes:
USAGE:
- {付箋|ふせん}を{貼|は}る (to stick a note)
- {付箋|ふせん}を{付|つ}ける (to attach a note)
- {付箋|ふせん}を{剥|は}がす (to peel off a note)

TYPES:
- ポストイット (Post-it - brand name, often used generically)
- {付箋紙|ふせんし} (sticky note paper)
- {見出|みだ}し{付箋|ふせん} (index tabs)

FUNCTIONS:
- Bookmarking pages
- Writing reminders
- Labeling items
- Color-coding information

OFFICE/SCHOOL:
Essential stationery item in Japanese offices and schools.

RELATED WORDS:
- メモ (memo, note)
- {付箋紙|ふせんし} (sticky note paper)
- しおり (bookmark)
